prior_result: PR #3220 improved two seeds by lowering trace learning rate, but one seed remained at the reward floor in every arm; the lambda-specific interaction rule failed. No prior shard is reused here.
hypothesis: At fixed lamda 0.8 and step_size 0.014, increasing gamma from 0.9 to 0.99 improves lifetime mean reward by giving distant upstream rewards a longer discounted horizon.
mechanism_basis: The default six-state chain needs five net upstream moves from its initial state. The discount weight at lag 20 changes from approximately 0.122 to 0.818; geometric discount scale 1/(1-gamma) changes from 10 to 100. These are algebraic motivation, not evidence that either discount has the wrong optimal policy. Increasing gamma also changes eligibility decay gamma*lambda from approximately 0.72 to 0.792 and changes value/TD-error scale. This single-factor probe measures the combined gamma intervention, not discount-horizon mediation separately from trace or stability effects.
design: One factor: gamma. Two fresh-process arms per seed, identical actual initialization and all other configuration values, same full runner and event budget. Default gamma is remeasured; no old numerical result is a baseline substitute.
seed_role: Fresh development seeds; never frozen-scorecard or scientific evaluation seeds.
primary_contrast: gamma_099 minus gamma_090 within each seed
primary_decision: The fixed sign/size screen passes only if every paired difference is strictly positive and mean exceeds 0.01. Report improvement only if that screen passes and mean also exceeds the across-seed sample SD. Otherwise report negative when mean <= 0, or inconclusive. No secondary rescue or reference selection.
fixed_controls: Default six-state RiverSwim; lamda 0.8, step_size 0.014; epsilon 0.5 to 0.02 over 2500 steps; empty hidden network and shared per-action biases. No initialization, reward, horizon, exploration, runner, trace mode or other intervention.
resource_policy: At most two CPU fresh processes concurrently in fixed pair schedule. OMP/OpenBLAS/MKL threads 1, JAX preallocation false. Equal event/update-attempt budgets. Endpoint numeric state bytes/leaves recorded; total process/native peak memory and qualified timing unmeasured. Excluded one-event API preflight seed 101099 for each arm.
integrity_policy: Public draft PR and clean input commit before comparisons. Freeze plan, run script AND validator before collection. Record all 228 framework/config/lockfile byte digests, source commit, runtime, UTC start/end, plan/script hashes, raw reward/action/state traces and read-only snapshots. No retries, substitutions, early stopping, gate changes or source drift. Stop later batches on any failure and retain the partial failure prefix and logs.
scope_limit: Permanently nonpromoting development probe, three seed pairs and two gamma values. Cannot establish an optimal discount, trace superiority, a pure horizon mechanism, sole cause of previous failure, confidence, generalization, transfer/retention, frozen-scorecard qualification, reference-dev or scientific evidence. Existing artifacts and gates immutable. This roster is consumed development data after execution.
